title: 車窓の旅
description: 無人の列車内から流れる風景を眺める、旅情のある車窓素材です。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 曇りがちな自然光と車内の弱い反射
tone.framing: 35mm・着席目線・16:9。窓枠と流れる景色を一定比率で入れる
tone.texture: 窓ガラスの薄い汚れ、布座席、金属枠、自然な動体ぶれ

pieces.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: view from an empty passenger train seat through a large window toward green countryside moving gently past
Scene/backdrop: ordinary regional train in daytime, completely unoccupied within the frame
Subject: window frame, small edge of plain seat, fields, trees, and soft motion blur, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic travel photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, seated eye-level, 35mm lens, window occupying most of the frame with stable horizon
Lighting/mood: soft overcast daylight with weak interior reflection, 5000K, calm forward-moving mood
Color palette: muted green, soft gray, faded blue, warm neutral fabric
Materials/textures: lightly marked glass, woven seat fabric, brushed metal frame, natural motion blur
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable text, no station signs, no logos, no brands, no watermark
Avoid: luxury train, famous route, dramatic speed streaks, fantasy, illustration, CGI look, oversaturation
